ConformanceAnswer.description: Per-condition answer; silence is not one of the values.
ConformanceAnswer.title: ConformanceAnswer

ConformanceDeclaration.description: The invariant answers on the face. There is deliberately no overall or total field: conformance is per-condition, mirroring the suite's refusal to collapse a profile into a single number.
ConformanceDeclaration.title: ConformanceDeclaration

Corollary.description: Section 2. One precision corollary, individuated by its condition and its two failure directions (a deficit and an imposition), not by a label. A corollary with no directions is not a corollary, so condition, deficit_direction, and imposition_direction are required.

condition.description: The iff condition the corollary specifies.

corrective.description: The corrective exemplar the standard cites.

id.description: The corollary handle (for example operational_definition, taxonomy_completeness).

Corollary.title: Corollary

FailurePattern.description: Section 7. One precision-failure pattern, individuated by its structural signature and its response. A pattern with no signature is a label, so signature and response are required.

id.description: The pattern handle (for example normative_substitution, category_collapse).

structural_signature.description: The observable signature that identifies the pattern.

FailurePattern.title: FailurePattern

PrecisionDeficit.description: Section 6.1. One entry in the precision deficit map.

decision.description: Section 6.5. The documented decision (remediation, acceptance with rationale, deferral, or not-a-deficit); required at Loop-Closed.

location.description: The document and location of the deficit.

pattern.description: The failure-pattern handle the deficit is keyed to.

PrecisionDeficit.title: PrecisionDeficit

PrecisionReview.description: A review of a governed artifact against the invariant, the ten corollaries, congruence, and the failure taxonomy, producing a deficit map.

adoption_depth.description: Section 6.1. The depth of the review (auditing, remediation, design-time).

conformance.description: The invariant answers on the face; no total.

congruence_checked.description: Section 3. Method-Structure Congruence was assessed for the artifact's production.

corollaries.description: Section 2. The ten corollaries the review assesses against, each a structured precision condition with its two failure directions.

deficits.description: Section 6.1. The precision deficit map, each deficit located and keyed to a failure pattern.

failure_patterns.description: Section 7. The precision-failure patterns the review keys deficits to, each a structured signature-and-response.
